title: Named tunnels are declared active on a fixed timer
test: tests/tunnel.test.js: 'a named tunnel whose process only stays alive does not resolve on a timer', 'a named tunnel resolves with the known URL when the registration line arrives on stdout', 'the registration line is recognized across chunk boundaries and in any letter case', 'other connection log lines do not count as registration', 'a named tunnel that never registers is stopped and rejected at timeoutMs', 'a named tunnel is not resolved by a trycloudflare URL in its output', 'a named tunnel whose process exits before registering rejects with the exit code', 'after registration the startup deadline is cleared and the process keeps running', 'the tunnel token reaches cloudflared only through the environment', 'output after a named tunnel registered is only logged'; tests/tunnelSupervisor.test.js: 'a named tunnel whose cloudflared stays alive without registering ends in error and a restart', plus 'a named tunnel stays starting until startTunnel resolves, then is active' and 'a tunnel start that rejects after a delay publishes error and schedules a restart' for the supervisor behaviour that already held
proof: Run on the unchanged launcher, with the fake child from TASK-029 (EventEmitter, PassThrough stdout and stderr, mock timers) and knownBaseUrl set: the child printed only 'INF Starting tunnel tunnelID=abc', stayed alive, and after tick(1500) launchCloudflaredCandidate resolved with { baseUrl: 'https://share.example.com', ... } although no connection was registered ('resolved without any registration line'; the same defect through TunnelSupervisor: status 'active' after tick(1500) with a silent, never-registering child, 'an unregistered process is not reported active'). In the same run 10 of the 23 tests in tests/tunnel.test.js failed (the 10 new named-tunnel tests); the 13 quick-tunnel tests of TASK-029 passed. After the fix all 23 and all 6 supervisor tests pass. The launcher no longer has the 1.5 s timer: for a named tunnel it scans the same per-stream rolling tail for /\bRegistered tunnel connection\b/i (constant NAMED_TUNNEL_REGISTERED; the word boundary keeps cloudflared's shutdown line 'Unregistered tunnel connection' from counting) and resolves with knownBaseUrl then; the timeoutMs deadline stays armed until that line, and on timeout stops the child and rejects with 'cloudflared did not register a tunnel connection within <n>ms'. TunnelSupervisor needed no change: it already publishes 'starting' until startTunnel resolves, and 'error' plus a backoff restart when it rejects (tests added; they passed on the unchanged supervisor). Not checked against a real cloudflared: none is installed on this machine, so the log text 'Registered tunnel connection' is from cloudflared's documented/known output, not from a run.
